01-topology: Shared physical topology. Foreground starts on the 10 Mbit/s primary branch. V2 adds h3-to-h4 background on alternate; V1 leaves that pair idle.
02-paired-differences: Individual ML-minus-trend bursty loss differences. V1 uses an idle alternate; V2 uses 4 Mbit/s background on a changed platform. Each point is one matched seed pair; cohorts are not pooled. Negative differences favor ML. Vertical scales differ.
03-aligned-captured-trace: V1 frozen-ML ramp: measured source, utilization and sampled queue occupancy. Orange dashed marks the decision; purple dotted marks first alternate UDP egress. These markers nearly coincide at this scale. Occupancy is not queueing delay.
04-forwarding-timing: V1 capture pilot: distinct timestamps relative to the decision. First alternate UDP is an outgoing software observation; final flow readback is a later CLI verification.

algorithm: Read all four branch qdiscs; wait for valid, contiguous causal history.
Evaluate the chosen trigger; suppress action on missing or stale observations.
Estimate foreground demand and alternate load; check link state, headroom and action limits.
If admitted, install the same selected-pair overlays and verify readback and packet counters.
After success, stop triggering; continue monitoring. Restore routing and shaping at cleanup.

parameters.caption: Common trigger and action settings; V2 adds measured alternate-path background load.

dataset.caption: Whole-run partitions and mutually exclusive row exclusions. Invalid-sample exclusions are zero in all accepted partitions.

network.caption: V1: means of three run outcomes per policy/scenario. RTT is mean within-run traffic-window probe p95.
network.note: All twelve steady trials had zero UDP sequence loss. Individual paired differences, rather than pooled polling samples, show variation.

prediction.caption: Held-out row-level prediction scores on fixed-primary traces.

validation.caption: V1 measurement and path validation. Rates are received UDP payload; overload rows show means.

v2loss.caption: V2 exploratory summaries: mean foreground UDP loss (%) over three seeds per cell.
v2loss.note: Includes V2’s three quality-tolerance exceptions, all at 14 Mbit/s background. At that load no intervention policy switched. Raw trial logs were unavailable for independent verification.
